title: Geometric Circle Post Template Pack Listing
whatItIs: A stock-vector listing page showing a five-piece template pack on light grey: a large post titled 'CREATIVE SOCIAL MEDIA POST TEMPLATE' plus four square variants, each built from crimson, navy and cream blocks holding circles and bullseyes in different arrangements.
whatItMeans: Showing several arrangements of the same modules proves the system can flex without changing its look.
techniques: One large hero post with four smaller variants
Blocks placed at the edges and corners
White space used as another block

vocabulary.definition: Several layouts sharing modules and palette.
